_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil: no momentum impulse, flat funding, F&G mid-50s; HOLD is the graded call until a breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative offers no forward call (low conf) — lean analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear/greed holds 47-54, funding stays near flat, BTC remains range-bound without momentum impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear/greed breaks above 62 with funding and 30d momentum expanding, or drops below 46 with vol spike and price breakdown
